_readme: Training / rehearsal case: matRad's HEAD_AND_NECK phantom, exported to DICOM with a matRad photon IMRT plan as the stand-in for the clinical plan (RP1/RD1), then imported back with cns_importDicom (made by matRad_example5_DWA_HN_training.m). Public, shareable. Single-level stand-in for a CNS case: CTV = GTV, PTV = PTV70, 70 Gy(RBE) in 35 fractions. PTV63 is not planned in the proton plans (no spots there).
dataClassNote: matRad HEAD_AND_NECK phantom (CORT), exported to DICOM by matRad
